title: Temporal comparand door: stale prose says every {placeholder} is stepped around, and the junk-literal sentence says "compare false for EVERY row"
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

From seat 5's contract review 7011051316 on PR #35508 (#35394), nits N3 and N4, combined into one card on the seat's word. Parent: #35394.

## What is stale
- **N3:** source and published-doc prose still say that every `{placeholder}` is stepped around by the temporal-comparand door. That has been false for period keys since #34938 and for context tokens since #35394. Places named by the review: `packages/objectql/src/temporal-comparand-door.ts:93` (module Scope note), `packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts:954`, `packages/core/src/utils/import-coerce.ts:350-351`, `packages/spec/src/data/filter-number-comparand-declared-type.ts:181-182` (published). Also `packages/objectql/src/validation/validate-rls-predicate-enforceability.ts:205-208`, which states which code a known placeholder on a temporal field gets.
- **N4:** the door's junk-literal consequence sentence (`temporal-comparand-door.ts:741`) says the comparand would "compare false for EVERY row". Under `$lt` it answered every row instead. The class shares the sentence, so the sentence is wrong for part of the class.

## Done when
Each sentence states the per-kind rule (date macros stepped around; period keys and context tokens judged as written; unknown and record-context left to the resolver). The consequence sentence says the comparison is made as text and may select every row or none. No behaviour changes.

## Grade
p3 · area:data · domain:server. Comments and published docblock only.
